question: Which floating garden will your heart choose?
intro_environment: A sweeping panorama of a skyward archipelago, islands drifting like lily pads across a sapphire expanse, with wisps of cloud weaving through them. A small couple wanders along a vine‑covered bridge, their silhouettes barely visible against the vastness.
intro_camera: Wide landscape camera, low horizon, capturing the breadth of the floating islands.
intro_couple_action: The couple strolls hand‑in‑hand, exploring a vine bridge that connects two islands, their tiny figures blending into the horizon.

choices.title: Mistfall Meadow
choices.description: A floating meadow of luminous mist and wildflowers, the ground a soft, translucent veil that shimmers with every step.
choices.composition: Diagonal path of mist leading from foreground to distant horizon, couple positioned off‑center to the left, with a cluster of glowing blossoms framing their rear.
choices.camera: Low angle, slightly wide, capturing the mist's depth and the couple's smallness.
choices.dominant_palette: Pastel greens, blush pinks, and soft lavender.
choices.couple_action: The couple pauses to touch a floating petal, their fingers brushing the air.

choices.title: Celestial Arch
choices.description: A towering stone archway carved from luminous quartz, suspended between two sky islands, its arches glittering with stardust.
choices.composition: Vertical composition centered on the arch, with the couple positioned to the right, looking up at the arch's apex.
choices.camera: High angle, slightly tilted, emphasizing the arch's height and the couple's smallness.
choices.dominant_palette: Muted greys, silver, and twilight blue.
choices.couple_action: The couple stands beneath the arch, gazing at the starlit sky reflected in the quartz.

choices.title: Nimbus Reef
choices.description: A reef of floating basalt islands, each teeming with bioluminescent coral that glows against the night sky.
choices.composition: Horizontal layout with a series of islands forming a chain, the couple on the far right island, a tide of luminous water beneath.
choices.camera: Eye‑level, slightly wide, capturing the depth of the water and the couple's position on the island.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep teal, cobalt blue, and electric green.
choices.couple_action: The couple wades through a shallow pool, watching the coral pulse.

choices.title: Echoing Grove
choices.description: A dense forest of crystal‑tinted trees that hum with the echo of distant winds, their trunks shimmering with iridescent light.
choices.composition: Tight frame of a winding path, the couple in the lower right, surrounded by towering trees that fade into a golden mist.
choices.camera: Low angle, wide, focusing on the path and the couple's movement.
choices.dominant_palette: Rich forest green, gold, and emerald.
choices.couple_action: The couple follows a glowing path, their footsteps leaving faint sparkles.
